279462350.description: This rectangular bookend is crafted from polished fossil stone, featuring a mix of browns, tans, and greys with natural fossil and mineral inclusions. The surface has a smooth, glossy finish that highlights the unique patterns formed by the embedded fossils. The bookend is freestanding and sturdy, suitable for supporting books or other items. There is no visible brand or manufacturer name on the piece.

279550875.description: This lot features a variety of tumbled and raw stones, crystals, and minerals including quartz, amethyst, and other semi-precious stones. Included is a decorative crescent moon ornament wire-wrapped with purple and green stones, glass beads, and charms. A notable piece is a yellow and brown mineral specimen with a rough, natural exterior. All items are in good display condition with no visible damage, and the collection includes a small Scorpio Zodiac Collection box.

This lot includes a collection of Skylanders figurines and toys-to-life accessories from the Activision Skylanders video game series.
